notes: Three new large maps: Harbor (72x48 m: crane tower with two decks and ramps, stacked container yard, warehouses with a corridor), Refinery (76x52 m: four storage tanks, a 44 m catwalk with side stairs, head-height pipe runs, control rooms) and Terminal (80x44 m: a long hall with doorways, pillars and a railed roof reached by ramps, lanes of cars, a bus, planters and kiosks).
